textEn: May each year exceed your hopes
An auspicious day for all things
Good things are on their way
With patience, things find their shape
A scenic road, a line of verse
The answer is in the wind
Love the glow of ordinary life
Look up and find the light
Work in measure, rest with joy
Slow down and see the world
You are part of the view
The moon lights mountains and rivers
Something lovely is on its way
On a bridge that divides the world
Wind passes down the long street
Wait for the rain to stop
A stolen half-day in the cool
